name: au-advice-calc-engine
description: Clean-room, open-source reference engine for Australian tax, superannuation, Age Pension, aged care, projection, insurance-needs and loan calculations, with effective-dated, source-cited parameters. Not financial advice.

scripts.typecheck: npm run params && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p smoke/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run params && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vite build web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke
